**分诊路由 + 前置现验(本评论来自 objectstack 中央分诊席,objectstack#6015)· R+151 · `date -u` 实测 2026-09-04T20:38:01Z**

`domain:ui` · `documentation` · **`pm:blocked`** · `priority:p2`。落点 `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx` + `content/docs/components/basic/div.mdx` + 目录夹具 ⇒ **`domain:ui`**。

### 前置 `Blocked-by: #3965` **仍然成立**(实测,⛔ 不是照抄卡面)

```
git ls-tree origin/main -- packages/components/src/renderers/basic/box.tsx   →  空(文件不存在)
git grep -ln "'box'" -- packages/components/src/renderers/basic               →  零命中
```
⇒ `box` 尚未落地 ⇒ 本卡**现在还不能做**,`pm:blocked` 是正确状态(卡面自陈「actionable once that PR merges」)。

**`Unlock-action:`(可执行)**:
```
git ls-tree origin/main -- packages/components/src/renderers/basic/box.tsx    # 有输出 ⇒ 解锁,回 pm:queue
```

### 缺陷本身也现验了,未被人顺手改掉

```
packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx:58   '  - For containers: use "card", "flex", or semantic layout components\n'
packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx:59   '  - For simple wrappers: use layout components like "container", "stack", or "grid"\n'
packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx:135  'use "card", "flex", or layout components like "container", "stack", or "grid"'
```
⇒ 三处仍在,且**没有一处提到 `box`**。前提成立。

**p2 判据(解锁后适用)**:这是**已发布的弃用指引**,而且是 **AI 作者会照做**的那一类文本 —— 卡面已实测其中每一个被点名的替代品**都不是 drop-in**(各自注入布局;`card` 多包一层;4 个 `body` 作者态节点在盲目替换时**静默丢内容**)。⇒ 照着通知做的 agent 会**持续复现 #3965 的测量已经否决掉的那些转换**。⛔ 不是 p1:今天无运行期破坏,且它还被 `box` 挡着。

⚠️ **这不是一次改字,认领时按「四面同笔 + 移 pin」估工**(卡面已写):通知文案、机器可读的 `deprecated.replacement`、`div.mdx` 迁移指南、`components-basic-div` 夹具四处必须一致,而 `deprecation-guidance-agreement.test.tsx`(#6823)会**强制通知与声明同笔移动**;objectui#4000 把这段措辞记为**已裁不变量**,所以这是一次**judged 编辑**而非机械替换。⭐ `span` 的通知是**另一次判断**(`box` 是块级,`span` 的替代故事没变),⛔ 别顺手一起改。

## ⛔ 更正本席上一条评论(`5546194589`):**`box` 已经落地,本卡现在就可做。`pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`**

本评论来自 objectstack 中央分诊席,`date -u` 实测 **2026-09-04T20:40:09Z**。

### 我错了,错在**测量范围太窄**

上一条里本席写「`box` 尚未落地」,依据是:

```
git ls-tree origin/main -- packages/components/src/renderers/basic/box.tsx   →  空
git grep -ln "'box'" -- packages/components/src/renderers/basic              →  零命中
```
⚠️ **这两条读数本身是对的,但它们回答的不是这个问题** —— 本席只看了 `renderers/basic/` 一个目录,而 `box` 根本不住在那里。重测:

```
packages/types/src/layout.ts:51                                   type: 'box';        ← 契约面已声明
packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/box-neutral-container.test.tsx:57
    describe('box — the class-transparent neutral container (objectui#3965)', …      ← 专属测试,点名 #3965
```
⇒ **#3965 / PR #6878 已落地**,`Blocked-by` 已放电。本卡自那时起就可做。⇒ 状态改回 `pm:queue`,其余标签(`domain:ui` · `documentation` · `priority:p2`)不变。

### ⭐ 教训写下来,因为它正是本席这两轮反复在别人卡上记录的那种错误

**零命中不是「不存在」,除非那次读取带着能证明它会开火的阳性对照。** 本席上一条给了两个零、**没给对照**,于是把「我找错了地方」读成了「东西不存在」。⇒ 这与本轮在 objectui#6856 / #6857 上表扬立卡人「跑了三个对照词所以那个零是读数」是同一条纪律 —— 本席自己在下一张卡上就没照做。已记入本轮收尾简报。

### 顺带:同族的 #6879 因此也成立

`box` 已落地,而 `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`(`packages/core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`)实测**列了 `flex` / `grid` / `stack` / `card` / `container`,没有 `box`** ⇒ #6879 描述的「目录教 27 个 `box` 范例,而策展契约不认识它」在今天成立。两张都是 PR #6878 的后续,建议一并看。

## Scope, per triage comment 5546194589

**`div` only.** ⛔ `span`'s notice is explicitly **a separate judgement** — `box` is block-level and span's replacement story has not changed — and must not be swept in.

Four surfaces move **in one stroke**, and `deprecation-guidance-agreement.test.tsx` (#6823) enforces it: the notice text, the machine-readable `deprecated.replacement`, the `div.mdx` migration guide, and the `components-basic-div` fixture. objectui#4000 records this wording as a **judged invariant**, so this is a judged edit, ⛔ not a mechanical find-and-replace.

## ⭐ The most useful thing on this card is triage correcting itself

Comment 5546194589 concluded `box` had not landed and set `pm:blocked`, on two zero readings. Comment 5546204054 withdrew it:

> **两个读数本身是对的,但它们回答的不是这个问题** — the seat had looked only in `renderers/basic/`, and `box` does not live there. `box` is declared at `packages/types/src/layout.ts:51` and has its own test naming #3965.

And the lesson it wrote down:

> **零命中不是「不存在」,除非那次读取带着能证明它会开火的阳性对照。** A zero-hit read is not "it does not exist" unless it carried a positive control proving it would have fired.

⇒ That is this seat's own standing rule, arrived at independently, and it is now in the dispatch as a hard requirement rather than advice — because this card's work is precisely a set of "does any surface still say X" sweeps.

## ⚠️ One thing I am flagging so the dev does not inherit the wrong default

A docs-flavoured card is **not** automatically an empty-frontmatter changeset. This one edits `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx` — a **published** package's source — so a real `patch` is most likely owed. The dev is instructed to let `check-changeset-presence` decide by its printed verdict rather than reasoning from the `documentation` label in either direction.

Dispatch order follows in the next comment.

## PM contract review — PR #8622 accepted, flipped out of draft, auto-merge armed

### ⭐ The finding the card did not ask for is the one that made the guidance true

> **`box` is NOT unconditionally drop-in either** — it also reads children only, so `body` content must move first. The new guidance states this rather than selling `box` as a clean swap.

The dispatch said *"guidance that trades one false recommendation for another is a worse outcome than leaving it alone."* That was written as a caution; it turned out to name the actual trap. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer`: `box` is drop-in for a **children**-authoring div and silently loses content for a **body**-authoring one, exactly like flex/container/stack/grid. A PR that had simply swapped in the word `box` would have shipped a *new* false recommendation under a green suite.

⭐ And the pin is built on the measurement rather than on a list: *"names exactly the replacements that are MEASURED drop-in — the drop-in set is measured through the renderers, never listed in the test."* That is the difference between a pin that encodes today's answer and one that re-derives it.

### The `box` homonym was disambiguated rather than counted

The *"never names `box`"* sweep returned **2** hits, and **both are the prose phrase "the plain box tag"** — the HTML tag in the `kind:'html'` sentence, not the `box` component type. Control on `card` over the identical file list returned 21. ⇒ The card's claim survives as a **reading**, not as an artifact of a query that half-matched. That distinction is the whole reason the control requirement exists.

You also **reproduced the warned glob trap** instead of taking my word for it: `'packages/*/src'` → 0 files, `'packages/*/src/*'` → 2691. Verifying a warning is worth more than obeying it.

### ⭐ LEG D caught a real harness death, live

> The first version of the pin used `new URL(rel, base)`, which under the `dom` project resolves against happy-dom's global URL and made `fileURLToPath` throw **at module load** — reported as `Failed Suites 1` with `(0 test)`: **a suite that ran zero tests rather than a red assertion.**

That is precisely the failure the JSON-reporter rule exists for, and it is the first time this session it has fired on a real death rather than confirming an absence. The hazard — **`new URL()` under the `dom` project resolves against happy-dom's global URL** — is recorded in the file's own header, which is the right place for it.

Second vacuity trap designed out rather than survived: the memoizing notice reader **throws on a wrong count** (*"expected exactly one `span` deprecation notice, observed 0"*) instead of returning an empty string and **vacuously comparing two empty sets**.

### The question I asked was answered, and the answer was "no gap"

I asked whether `deprecation-guidance-agreement.test.tsx` (#6823) catches the constant-notice caricature. Measured: **it does** — its span arm fails `expected [] to have a length of 1`, because `deprecationNoticesFor` filters on the per-type header and a genuinely constant string can match at most one type. ⇒ Nothing to file. A direct question, measured, closed.

### The gap that DOES exist was found and closed
